{{Quote|The situation there was vastly different. ''[&hellip;]'' The forces on Oristrom were well supplied and well entrenched. And there were a great deal more of them.|Stromma Council Liaison Nyama|<ref name="Crisis" />}}
At some point after a [[Battle of the Poln system|battle]] in the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]] [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]], a '''battle''' was fought on the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oristrom]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Stromma]] [[Species/Legends|species]], between the [[Empire of the Hand]] and [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva's realm]]. A number greater than twenty-nine of [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|Chosen]], [[Nuso Esva|Esva's]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]], were well supplied and entrenched and had the lower hand until Esva assumed [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]].<ref name="Crisis" />

However, Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]]<ref name="Crisis" /> [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] [[Core name/Legends|"Thrawn"]]<ref name="Specter">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref> arrived and was able to defeat [[Nuso Esva|Esva's]] forces by studying [[Painting/Legends|art]].<ref name="Crisis" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Empire of the Hand [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] reminded [[Stromma Council Liaison]] [[Nyama]] of how Thrawn's "obsession" with art freed the Stromma after the Council Liaison stated that the Chiss's obsession was more unsettling than the warlord.<ref name="Crisis" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was mentioned in the [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and included within the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of Zahn's [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis" />
